name: Sima
source:
One of the girls living within the castle at the flower garden, she is a cheerful and laid-back girl who always lightens up the mood around her. Nobody notices the darkness lurking behind her smile.

[Translated from [url=https://enoshima210.work/2018/08/10/vanilla/]Official Site[/url]]
